line_items.reasoning: Q4 revenue of $13.7B came in at the high end of the guided range of $12.8B–$13.8B, exceeding the $13.3B midpoint and marking the fifth consecutive quarter of beating guidance.
Non-GAAP EPS beat was explicitly attributed in part to 'stronger gross margins,' implying actual gross margin came in above the guided ~36.5%.
Non-GAAP EPS of $0.15 nearly doubled the guided $0.08, driven by higher revenue, better margins, and spending discipline.
No specific Q4 CapEx deviation was reported; the company did not flag any departure from the guided ~$18B gross CapEx for 2025.
DCAI grew 15% sequentially (the fastest sequential growth this decade), clearly exceeding the 'up strongly' guidance, while CCG directional performance was not flagged as a miss.
